terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/optix-data" && DATA_DIR="$HOME/optix-data" ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost,127.0.0.1 HOST_BIND=127.0.0.1 PORT=2000 .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 2000 --app-dir backend
terminals.description: Optix Pro FastAPI backend serving the prebuilt SPA and JSON API on http://localhost:2000 (health at /health, readiness at /ready). Runs directly with uvicorn since Cloud Agent VMs have no Docker daemon; runtime data lives in $HOME/optix-data.
